name.full: Claw PC - let Cowork work on your Windows PC

description.short: Run commands, PowerShell, files and long jobs on your own Windows PC.
description.full: Connects Copilot Cowork to the Claw server running on your own Windows PC through a private Microsoft dev tunnel. Cowork can run commands and PowerShell 7 scripts, read, write and search files, run long tasks as background jobs, and inspect the machine. Start-Claw.cmd from https://github.com/ogradyliam5/copilot-cowork-claw builds this plugin with your own secret URL.

agentConnectors.description: Operate the user's own Windows PC (Claw PC): run commands and PowerShell 7 scripts, read, write and search files, run long tasks as background jobs, and inspect the machine (OS, runtimes, disks, processes).
